children.text: After completing this unit, you will be able to:
describe the birth and early development of agriculture and the traditional farming method of milpa;
introduce the contributions of Chinese agriculture to global civilization, from the Silk Road to the Belt and Road Initiative;
write an extended definition of a specific farming method;
design a scan-to-listen poster that demonstrates how a region preserves its agricultural heritage while integrating modern innovations.

children.style: --editor-theme-primary-color: #ffb600ff; margin-top: calc(40px * var(--editor-margin-scale)); margin-bottom: calc(16px * var(--editor-margin-scale)); line-height: 1.2

children.text: The advent of agriculture marked a transformative milestone in human history, as humans began purposefully cultivating crops for food. From early farming in fertile river valleys to today's advanced agricultural practices, agriculture has evolved through continuous innovation. With all the new challenges and opportunities we face today, preserving agriculture's rich heritage becomes imperative, as it offers enduring wisdom and strength. To carry this heritage forward, agricultural institutions from China and other countries have jointly hosted an online exchange focused on preserving farming culture and fostering innovation. As a participant, you are invited to introduce regional farming practices by creating a QR code poster with an accompanying audio explanation, to be displayed on the event platform.

It evolved as a mini meal to stem the hunger and anticipation of an evening meal at around 8 p.m. The Duchess began ordering tea and snacks to her room during the late afternoon to ward off hunger pangs. Finding this private ritual both satisfying and enjoyable, she soon began inviting friends to join her for afternoon tea. children.text: Parenthetical phrases, also known simply as parentheticals, can be a great way to add flow and concision to an essay. In essence, a parenthetical is just a phrase and can be removed without changing the main grammatical structure of the sentence. However, just because it isn't essential does not mean that it isn't important. These phrases make writing more descriptive, formal, and informative. Normally a parenthetical element has a comma before and after it. You might also choose to use parentheses or dashes to separate a parenthetical element from the rest of the sentence.
Here are some examples in the passage "Silk and seeds: China's agrarian threads across time":
one of the cradles of global agriculture
, has shared the bounty of its land with the world for millennia.
no less profound than those of papermaking or gunpowder
, have helped weave Chinese agricultural traditions into the broader fabric of world civilization.
, they became subjects of extensive research and practical application.
from the early rice paddies that sustained ancient civilizations to today's AI-powered smart greenhouses, from the Ancient Tea Horse Road to modern digital supply chains distributing crops globally
– demonstrates agriculture's enduring power as a bridge across cultures and borders.
Complete the sentences by choosing the correct phrases.

children.text: Designing a scan-to-listen poster on preserving agricultural heritage while integrating innovations

In this unit, we have learned about the Maya's traditional milpa farming and the contributions of Chinese agriculture to world civilization. Over time, farming cultures dynamically evolve while their roots stay firmly anchored. For the international exchange organized by farming institutions, you are going to create a poster analyzing the dual dynamics of preservation and innovation in your region's agricultural heritage. For example, how are traditional farming practices being actively sustained in your region? What modern innovations like digital tools have been integrated? With the poster, you will create a three-minute audio narration explaining your analysis.
Form groups of three or four and select a region. It could be your hometown, the area you currently live in, or a place that interests you.
Investigate how your chosen region preserves its farming traditions while fostering innovation. You may consider the following points:
Transmission of farming knowledge (e.g., through education or library archives)
Community participation in agricultural activities (e.g., festivals or volunteer programs)
Use of modern technology (e.g., using drones or marketing apps)
Academic partnerships (e.g., developing better seeds or protecting soil)
Government support (e.g., government policies or funding for traditional farming)
Organize your findings and highlight at least three of your key points that most effectively demonstrate your region's agricultural evolution in your poster.

Create a visually compelling and informative poster. Ensure that the poster effectively guides your viewers through the evolution of your region's agricultural practices – from historical roots to contemporary innovations.
Keep the design simple and focused, with a bold title, concise content, and clear structure.
Use high-quality images, readable fonts, and a balanced color scheme with good contrast.
Highlight key elements through size and placement while leaving white space to avoid clutter.
Proofread for errors to ensure clarity and accuracy in your poster's content.

Develop a three-minute script that follows and complements your poster's visual content, and then read and record your script. Add background sounds or music if necessary.
Generate a QR code and share your poster
Create a QR code linking to your audio recording and integrate it into your poster design. Once your poster is complete, upload it to the exchange platform.
